      RISK MANAGEMENT AND INTERNAL CONTROL                                           風險管理及內部控制
      The Board acknowledges its responsibility to ensure that sound risk            董事會確認其有責任確保公司建立和維持在本

      Such system aims at managing and reducing the business risks faced             程度內管理和降低本集團面臨的與其業務相關
      by the Group to an acceptable extent, but not eliminating the risks of         的風險，而非消除未能達成業務目標的風險，

      reasonable and not absolute assurance against material misstatement,           合理而非絕對的保證。
      loss or fraud.

    (a)   Credit risk                                                         (a)   信貸風險
          Credit risk refers to the risk that a counterparty will default           信貸風險指因交易對手方違反其合
          on its contractual obligations resulting in a financial loss to           同義務而導致本集團蒙受財務損失

          amortised cost and trade and other receivables.                           他金融資產以及貿易及其他應收款
                                                                                    項。

          Cash at bank                                                              銀行存款

          financial institutions, for which the Group considers to have             機構，本集團認為該等金融機構具
          low credit risk.                                                          有低信貸風險。

          customers. The Group has no concentrations of credit risk                 團的客戶數目眾多，故並無信貸風
